text:
jess: Heads up — support flagged a customer where a streaming session reconnect + toolcall led to what looks like duplicate token charges after truncation. anyone seen this pattern?

sam: yup, saw a spike overnight. provisional ledger had two entries for the same suffix tokens when client resumed and then a toolcall TTL expired. :grimacing:

priya: can you paste a quick trace? need session_id, resume_offset, any toolcall id.

jess: here's the sanitized snippet from support logs:
```
session_id: s-01F3eX
client_resume_offset: 4096
last_ack_offset: 3072
toolcall: { id: tc-88, ttl_ms: 12000, state: PENDING }
stream_truncated: true
router_path: region-a -> region-b fallback
billing: provisional: tokens=42, confirmed: 0
```

alex: probable cause: router creates a new session (different session_id) on fallback and we don't reconcile provisional suffix ownership. the old session had a pending toolcall whose TTL expired later and then finalized charges against the original ledger slice. new session also created provisional credits for the resumed suffix. both got billed.

maria: agreed. two quick low-risk heuristics: (1) attach toolcall idempotency to the stream prefix so finalization is attributed to the active session if resume_offset <= last_finalized_offset; (2) mark any suffix tokens as provisional until we get either toolcall confirmation or a final stream EOF ack.

priya: instrumentation we should add ASAP for telemetry + console: add fields on stream events: `session_resume_offset`, `last_finalized_token_idx`, `toolcall_id`, `toolcall_confirmed` (t/f), `provisional_charge_id`. Also expose `provisional_to_confirmed_ratio` per-route in Console.

billing-bot: provisional_charge created: id=pc-772, customer=acct-900, amount=0.0043 USD, tokens=42

darren: +1 to showing provisional vs confirmed breakdown in the billing tab. product asked for a separate column for "provisional exposure" so SRE/CS can triage before invoices. can we add a hover explainer?

alex: implementation note: if we use the idempotency-on-toolcall approach we avoid altering ledger format. we need a small change in router: when resuming, consult `last_finalized_token_idx` from the ledger service and suppress provisional charges for offsets <= that.

maria: rollout plan: canary 10% traffic -> measure `provisional_dup_charge_rate` and `provisional_to_confirmed_lag`. if metrics look good after 48h, roll to 50% then all. fallback: feature flag to force old behavior for affected tenants.

priya: test cases: - resume with offset < last_finalized (no new provisional) - resume with offset > last_finalized (new provisional created) - toolcall confirm after resume -> confirm charges attributed once - toolcall TTL race -> ensure dedupe by `toolcall_id`

jess: action items: priya to add telemetry schema + unit tests, alex to prototype idempotency attachment in router, maria to add console mock for provisional column, darren to coordinate CS messaging. I'll file an incident-ticket for the affected customer.

sam: pinging @oncall to watch for billing alerts while we canary. will add alert rule: provisional_to_confirmed_ratio > 0.6 for 10m.

priya: adding note — we should also document behavior in internal API docs about "provisional" vs "confirmed" semantics so SDKs can surface warnings to customers.

jess: thanks all. keeping this thread open for canary numbers. :thumbsup:
